scenarios.scenario: A client attempts a semantic mutation from a stale base/current-state version.
scenarios.detection: Submitted base revision/current-state version differs from the latest eligible version required by the mutation.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Reject the unsafe mutation and return the current version/revalidation path; never apply against stale state.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show stale/revalidation-required state and the current version needed to continue.
scenarios.recovery: Client re-reads current state and retries or enters revalidation.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Concurrent stale attempts must not create duplicate or partial mutations.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Record the rejected stale mutation attempt with Actor, Project, base/current versions and correlation/causation identifiers.
scenarios.requiredProof: Contract and concurrency tests for stale-base rejection and revalidation.

scenarios.scenario: An authoritative Source changes while reconciliation or review is in progress.
scenarios.detection: Relevant Source frontier/evidence version no longer matches the snapshot used by the in-flight work.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Preserve the new Source observation, mark affected work stale, and require revalidation before durable acceptance.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Surface that the Source changed and the affected proposal/reconciliation requires revalidation.
scenarios.recovery: Refetch/reconcile against the new Source frontier and re-run eligibility/review as required.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: No stale in-flight result may win a race against a newer relevant Source frontier.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit the Source frontier change and any aborted/revalidated operation.
scenarios.requiredProof: Race test where Source advances during review/reconciliation and stale acceptance is blocked.

scenarios.scenario: A pending Proposal Item becomes stale before a reviewer acts.
scenarios.detection: Current Source/Candidate/Context basis differs materially from the Proposal Item's captured basis.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Block approval of the affected item until item-level revalidation establishes a current basis.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Mark the item stale/revalidation-required rather than presenting it as review-ready.
scenarios.recovery: Revalidate into the same or a successor disposition according to 10K/10L proof-gated mechanics.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Concurrent review and staleness detection must fail closed; no double decision or stale revision.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit staleness detection, attempted blocked decision, and revalidation outcome.
scenarios.requiredProof: Proposal staleness race tests covering approve/edit/batch paths.

scenarios.scenario: The same evidence is observed repeatedly or through duplicate delivery/processing paths.
scenarios.detection: Canonical Evidence Reference identity/content/source basis matches an already accepted reference.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Deduplicate the duplicate reference without collapsing distinct provenance from genuinely different Sources/scopes.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Avoid duplicate evidence noise while retaining accurate provenance.
scenarios.recovery: Reuse the canonical reference or create a distinct reference only when source/provenance identity differs.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Concurrent duplicate creation must converge on one canonical duplicate disposition.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit duplicate intake/processing at the Operation or provider-event level where applicable.
scenarios.requiredProof: Concurrent duplicate-evidence tests including same-content/different-source cases.

scenarios.scenario: Two qualified pieces of evidence support incompatible claims.
scenarios.detection: Deterministic/model-assisted reconciliation identifies incompatible assertions that cannot be resolved by authority/freshness alone.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Preserve both evidence bases and create/maintain Conflict; never silently overwrite one claim.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Expose Conflict distinctly from Uncertainty and prevent it being presented as settled truth.
scenarios.recovery: Resolve only through authoritative evidence or first-party governed conflict resolution/revalidation.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Repeated detection enriches the same semantic conflict rather than creating uncontrolled duplicates.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit conflict creation, evidence linkage, and later resolution.
scenarios.requiredProof: Conflict fixtures across Source/Working/Reviewed planes and resolution tests.

scenarios.scenario: An authoritative or relevant Source cannot be reached.
scenarios.detection: Provider fetch/current-ref operation fails or authorization/connectivity prevents observation.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Retain truthful last-observed metadata, mark freshness unavailable/stale as appropriate, and never fabricate current Source state.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Surface degraded Source freshness and any affected trust/coverage limitation.
scenarios.recovery: Retry/catch up after provider recovery or reconnection; revalidate freshness-sensitive work.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Retries must not regress newer observations or duplicate semantic work.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit Source failure/recovery Operations without leaking credentials.
scenarios.requiredProof: Unavailable/recovery tests proving truthful stale qualification and no invented state.

scenarios.scenario: Memoid loses authorization to a connected Source.
scenarios.detection: Provider/token/installation/grant check indicates Source access is revoked.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Stop fetches, fence queued Source work, revoke affected access paths, and preserve historical provenance without claiming freshness.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show disconnected/authorization-required Source state and impacted freshness/coverage.
scenarios.recovery: Explicit authorized reconnection followed by server-controlled catch-up and revalidation.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Queued/in-flight work reauthorizes before side effects and fails closed after revocation.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit revocation, fenced work, and reconnection.

scenarios.scenario: The GitHub App installation or repository access is removed.
scenarios.detection: GitHub provider reports installation/repository access no longer available.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Disable affected Sources and catch-up paths; preserve historical evidence and never infer semantic deletion from installation removal.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show GitHub connection/source unavailable and stale coverage.
scenarios.recovery: Reinstall/regrant explicitly, resolve stable provider repository identity, then catch up.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Duplicate removal signals converge; queued fetches fail closed.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit installation removal/reconnection using stable provider identities.

scenarios.scenario: The connected GitHub repository is renamed or transferred.
scenarios.detection: Provider repository ID matches but mutable owner/name/URL metadata differs.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Preserve stable Source identity using provider repository ID and update mutable metadata without creating a replacement Source.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Display current repository metadata while preserving continuity/history.
scenarios.recovery: Refetch provider metadata/current ref and continue processing.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Concurrent rename/transfer signals cannot create duplicate repository identities.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit metadata identity transition.
scenarios.requiredProof: Rename/transfer tests proving stable provider-ID binding.

scenarios.scenario: A previously received GitHub delivery is replayed.
scenarios.detection: Delivery deduplication identity matches a durably receipted provider event.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Acknowledge/deduplicate safely and do not repeat authoritative semantic mutation; refetch only if needed for catch-up policy.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Normally none; no duplicate Proposal/revision noise.
scenarios.recovery: Return stable receipt/disposition and continue current frontier processing.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Same delivery handled idempotently under sequential/concurrent replay.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Retain auditable provider-event receipt/dedupe disposition.

scenarios.scenario: Authenticated GitHub deliveries arrive out of chronological/provider-ref order.
scenarios.detection: Delivery/ref metadata indicates an older event arrives after a newer desired/current provider state is known.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Treat the delivery as a signal, refetch authoritative provider state, and never regress desired/current Source frontier.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Normally background; expose Source staleness/operation state only when convergence is delayed.
scenarios.recovery: Converge through provider refetch/catch-up rather than replaying event semantics blindly.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Out-of-order events must be idempotent and monotonic with respect to desired current state.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit receipt ordering and convergence operation.
scenarios.requiredProof: Out-of-order delivery tests proving no frontier regression.

scenarios.scenario: A GitHub push delivery is missing, substantially delayed, or not usable for timely processing.
scenarios.detection: Scheduled/reconnect/current-ref comparison finds provider state ahead of Memoid observed/desired frontier.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Server-controlled catch-up advances desired Source frontier from authoritative provider state; webhook delivery is not the correctness mechanism.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Surface Source stale/catching-up status when relevant.
scenarios.recovery: Scheduled integrity check, reconnect comparison, failed-operation retry, or optional provider redelivery recovery.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Catch-up must converge idempotently with late/replayed webhooks.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit catch-up detection and resulting operation.
scenarios.requiredProof: Missed/delayed webhook recovery test with authoritative ref comparison.

scenarios.scenario: A push advances desired Source frontier while a worker is processing an earlier desired snapshot.
scenarios.detection: Post-completion desired-frontier recheck observes a newer desired frontier than the worker processed.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Complete the processed frontier transactionally and durably require follow-up processing for the newer desired frontier.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Source may remain catching up until newest desired frontier is processed.
scenarios.recovery: Schedule/retain follow-up work before quiescence.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Lost wakeup forbidden; lease/ownership/exact lock mechanism remains proof-gated.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit processing frontier and follow-up scheduling/Operation linkage.
scenarios.requiredProof: Lost-wakeup integration test including desired 105 -> 106 during processing.

scenarios.scenario: A burst of many GitHub pushes arrives before processing catches up.
scenarios.detection: Multiple deduplicated provider deliveries advance desired frontier faster than reconciliation completes.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Keep deliveries individually auditable while coalescing contiguous processing; never equate fifty commits with fifty model runs or semantic changes.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show catching-up/operation state and semantic backlog rather than event-count review noise.
scenarios.recovery: Process/coalesce incrementally until desired frontier converges.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Burst scheduling must avoid duplicate full processing and lost wakeups.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit each provider receipt plus coalesced processing Operations.
scenarios.requiredProof: 50-push burst/load/race test proving coalescing and convergence.

scenarios.scenario: The tracked Git ref is force-pushed to a non-ancestral history.
scenarios.detection: Provider refetch/current graph shows new ref is not a simple descendant of processed frontier.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Refetch current provider state, preserve historical Memoid evidence/history, and revalidate affected work; do not model it as a simple linear frontier advance.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Surface topology/currentness change where it affects reviewed coverage or pending work.
scenarios.recovery: Re-ingest/reconcile affected scopes from authoritative current state using proof-gated diff strategy.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Concurrent old/new deliveries cannot restore rewritten history as current truth.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit topology rewrite and revalidation operation.

scenarios.scenario: Evidence or a checkpoint describes implementation that exists only on a non-default feature branch.
scenarios.detection: Evidence ref/branch scope is non-default and not established as current default-branch implementation.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Keep it branch-scoped candidate/future implementation evidence; it may inform Working Context but must not silently replace current default-branch implementation truth.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Label branch scope/future state distinctly in Working/Resume/review surfaces.
scenarios.recovery: After merge, authoritative default-branch provider refetch establishes new current implementation evidence.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Concurrent default/non-default observations retain scope and authority rather than last-writer-wins.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Preserve branch/ref provenance in evidence and decisions.
scenarios.requiredProof: Branch/default-branch authority fixtures and merge transition tests.

scenarios.scenario: Model provider outage, quota exhaustion, or HTTP 429 occurs after a checkpoint was durably accepted.
scenarios.detection: Provider call cannot proceed/complete because provider is unavailable, quota-exhausted, or rate-limited after deterministic intake succeeded.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Preserve accepted Candidate as explicitly pending/unreconciled lower-trust continuity; Source/Candidate intake continues and recent work does not disappear.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Resume/Operations show provider degradation and pending/unreconciled trust class without overriding Reviewed/authoritative state.
scenarios.recovery: Retry when configured provider recovers or use only an explicit allowlisted privacy-compatible fallback; then reconcile current basis.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Retries/fallback must not duplicate Candidate intake, Proposals or Revisions.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit provider role/failure, Operation, retry/fallback and bounded model provenance without raw sensitive prompts.

scenarios.scenario: Source content contains control-like text such as instructions to ignore rules or approve changes.
scenarios.detection: Untrusted Source content reaches classification/secret-scan/model packet path and contains instruction-like material.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Treat it only as evidence; it has zero control authority and cannot alter authorization, review policy, Source Authority, or trusted Context directly.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Only surface a security/injection warning when relevant; never present injected commands as approved instructions.
scenarios.recovery: Redact/minimize/qualify and continue safely or route affected output to review according to policy.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Repeated malicious content cannot escalate control authority across retries.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit security classification/failure at bounded metadata level; do not persist secrets unnecessarily.
scenarios.requiredProof: Prompt-injection fixtures proving model output cannot bypass deterministic controls.

scenarios.scenario: Candidate Submission contains malicious instructions, secret-like material, malformed assertions or adversarial content.
scenarios.detection: Deterministic authorization/validation/secret scan/classification identifies unsafe or unqualified Candidate content.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Never trust on receipt; redact/minimize/reject/qualify before model use and prevent credentials becoming Context/Pack data.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Return sanitized validation/security status without exposing secrets.
scenarios.recovery: User/client resubmits safe bounded evidence if appropriate.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Rejected/unsafe attempts cannot advance trusted semantic state; duplicate malicious submissions remain bounded.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit sanitized security decision, Actor/Integration and correlation identifiers.
scenarios.requiredProof: Malicious candidate/secret/injection contract and security tests.

scenarios.scenario: A user invokes checkpoint and the submitting AI extracts assertions including AI-only inferences.
scenarios.detection: Candidate item origin is AI-inferred and no separate sufficiently trustworthy user-confirmation signal exists.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Record the actual assertion origin/confirmation basis. The checkpoint means 'submit the extracted checkpoint', not 'the user confirms every extracted fact'.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Working/review surfaces retain origin/confirmation qualification for affected items.
scenarios.recovery: Obtain explicit trusted confirmation or independent authoritative support where automatic eligibility needs it.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Checkpoint retries preserve origin; they cannot upgrade AI inference to user-confirmed by repetition.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit submission Actor/Integration plus assertion-origin/confirmation basis without conflating model metadata with Actor identity.
scenarios.requiredProof: Checkpoint origin fixtures including hosts with and without trustworthy confirmation capability.

scenarios.scenario: A model labels an AI-inferred assertion high-confidence, NEW/CHANGED, important, or otherwise eligible-looking.
scenarios.detection: Automatic eligibility input lacks an independently allowed evidence/origin basis even though model confidence/importance is high.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Deny automatic durable acceptance. Model confidence/classification/checkpoint invocation alone never proves eligibility.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Keep the item in Working Context/review candidate state with its origin and uncertainty/provenance visible.
scenarios.recovery: Obtain authoritative support or another canonically allowed basis, then re-evaluate under current policy/frontiers.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Concurrent evaluations must not turn model output into approval authority.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit eligibility denial reason and model provenance used for reasoning.
scenarios.requiredProof: Automatic-eligibility tests where high model confidence remains insufficient.

scenarios.scenario: Later Candidate sequence completes while an earlier accepted sequence remains processing or unstable.
scenarios.detection: Accepted sequence set contains a gap in stable dispositions, e.g. 47/48 stable, 49 processing, 50 stable.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Candidate Reconciled Frontier remains highest contiguous stable disposition (48) plus explicit later-completion knowledge, or equivalent gap-preserving representation; never report 50 as if 49 completed.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Operations/continuity may expose pending gap when relevant; never claim complete reconciliation beyond it.
scenarios.recovery: Process/retry missing sequence until stable, then advance contiguous frontier.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Out-of-order completion must preserve gap; concurrent workers cannot leapfrog the canonical watermark.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit Candidate sequence dispositions/Operations sufficient to explain gap and advancement.

scenarios.scenario: Review policy or relevant Source/Candidate/Context basis changes after automatic eligibility reasoning but before durable mutation.
scenarios.detection: Final re-read/CAS-style check finds policy version or relevant frontier/current-state version differs from reasoning snapshot.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Abort stale automatic acceptance and re-evaluate; do not commit using only the earlier eligibility snapshot.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show re-evaluation/pending review rather than a stale automatic success.
scenarios.recovery: Run eligibility against current policy/frontiers and route protected/uncertain results to human review.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Exactly one current-basis revision at most; stale concurrent attempts cannot commit.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit aborted stale attempt, basis versions and subsequent disposition.
scenarios.requiredProof: Policy/frontier race tests with final current-basis recheck.

scenarios.scenario: Project review policy changes from MANUAL to AUTOMATIC while pending items exist.
scenarios.detection: New monotonic policy version becomes effective with items captured under prior MANUAL snapshot.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Apply the new policy prospectively. Existing pending items remain under their original snapshot; no silent mass acceptance.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Backlog remains pending/reviewable with original policy basis; new work follows current policy.
scenarios.recovery: Later explicit first-party reevaluation may exist only through governed semantics.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Policy transition and pending-item processing cannot race into unintended bulk acceptance.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit human Actor, step-up, old/new policy version/effective time and subsequent item decisions.

scenarios.scenario: Project review policy changes from AUTOMATIC to MANUAL.
scenarios.detection: New monotonic MANUAL policy version becomes effective.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Previously accepted Context Revisions remain immutable history; future eligible semantic mutations require human review.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show current MANUAL policy and retain prior automatic history/provenance.
scenarios.recovery: Corrections use successor Revisions; no history rewrite.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: In-flight automatic commits must pass final current-policy recheck and abort if MANUAL is now effective.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit human Actor, step-up, policy transition and any aborted in-flight auto action.
scenarios.requiredProof: Automatic->Manual transition with in-flight eligibility test.

scenarios.scenario: An MCP host reports misleading or spoofed clientInfo metadata.
scenarios.detection: Self-reported host metadata differs from authenticated Integration/Credential/grant identity or is otherwise unverifiable.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Treat clientInfo only as metadata; authorize using stable authenticated Integration/Credential identity and Project grants.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Audit/integration UI distinguishes authenticated identity from self-reported host metadata.
scenarios.recovery: No special recovery; correct metadata may appear on future authorized requests.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: NOT_APPLICABLE
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit authenticated identity and optionally self-reported metadata without conflation.

scenarios.scenario: An Integration/Developer Project grant is revoked while a protected request is in flight.
scenarios.detection: Authorization recheck before protected side effect no longer permits the Actor/Integration.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Fail closed before side effect; do not rely solely on authorization captured at request start.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Return access-revoked/denied without leaking Project details.
scenarios.recovery: Freshly authorize only after an explicit new grant.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Revocation must win over stale authorization snapshots; retries remain denied until regranted.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit revocation and denied in-flight action.

scenarios.scenario: A PostgreSQL pooled connection is reused across tenant/project operations.
scenarios.detection: Integration test exercises sequential/concurrent transactions for distinct tenant scopes on the same pool.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Transaction-local RLS/session context and reset discipline prevent cross-tenant leakage.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: No cross-tenant disclosure; denial remains indistinguishable where required.
scenarios.recovery: Fail readiness/security tests and fix isolation before governed data path ships.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Concurrent pool use cannot leak prior transaction context.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Security tests/logs use synthetic identifiers and no sensitive data.
scenarios.requiredProof: Real pooled-connection cross-tenant RLS integration tests.

scenarios.scenario: A principal probes object identifiers belonging to another Project/tenant.
scenarios.detection: Authorization/RLS resolves object outside caller's permitted Project scope.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Deny with non-enumerating/indistinguishable not-found semantics where applicable; never leak object existence/data.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Generic denied/not-found result.
scenarios.recovery: NOT_APPLICABLE
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: NOT_APPLICABLE
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit suspected cross-Project access attempt with sanitized identifiers/Actor attribution.

scenarios.scenario: A queued/background job reaches execution after the initiating grant/session/integration was revoked.
scenarios.detection: Execution-time authorization recheck fails.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Terminate/deny the Operation before protected side effect; queued authorization is not permanent authority.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Operation shows authorization-revoked/failed state without leaking protected content.
scenarios.recovery: Explicitly reauthorize and create/retry only through a fresh permitted path.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Retries continue to reauthorize and cannot bypass revocation.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit queued origin, execution-time denial and correlation/causation.

scenarios.scenario: The same authorized side-effect request is submitted repeatedly or concurrently with the same scoped idempotency key.
scenarios.detection: Idempotency store detects the same key in the same canonical scope.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Return the stable prior/in-progress result and create at most one governed side effect.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: User sees one operation/result, not duplicate revisions/proposals/actions.
scenarios.recovery: Retry safely using the same key/result contract.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Exactly-once effect under at-least-once request delivery; exact retention/storage mechanism proof-gated.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit one logical operation with correlated duplicate attempts.
scenarios.requiredProof: Sequential and concurrent duplicate-request idempotency tests.

scenarios.scenario: A Project enters deletion-pending while new writes or jobs attempt to mutate it.
scenarios.detection: Lifecycle state is deletion-pending/deleting before a protected write/job side effect.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Fence new writes and downstream jobs; deletion access revocation precedes erasure.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show deletion pending and block new mutations.
scenarios.recovery: Only governed cancellation/restore during allowed grace (if canonical) or completion; exact saga mechanics proof-gated.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Deletion fence wins over stale write snapshots; retries do not resurrect writes.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit deletion transition, fenced operations and final outcome.

scenarios.scenario: A restore request races with deletion progression.
scenarios.detection: Concurrent lifecycle operations target incompatible archive/delete/restore states.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Serialize/guard lifecycle transitions so no partial resurrection or mixed active/deleting state is possible.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show one truthful lifecycle/Operation state and explicit failure if restore is no longer allowed.
scenarios.recovery: Retry only from a valid lifecycle state according to 10S proof-gated state machine.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Mutually exclusive lifecycle transitions are concurrency-safe and idempotent.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit both requests and authoritative winning transition.

scenarios.scenario: Backup/restore media still contains data from a deleted Project.
scenarios.detection: Restore/deletion drill identifies tombstoned/deleted tenant data in backup lineage.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Retention/tombstone process prevents deleted data from reappearing as active state after restore.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: No deleted Project/data reappears; privacy/deletion status remains truthful.
scenarios.recovery: Apply deletion/tombstone reconciliation after restore; exact retention mechanism proof-gated.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Repeated restore/delete reconciliation remains idempotent.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit deletion/restore drill without exposing deleted content.

scenarios.scenario: A task-relevant Resume Pack must include context with an unresolved Conflict.
scenarios.detection: Selected qualified context intersects an open Conflict.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Include/qualify the conflict according to canonical selection rules; never present either side as settled current truth.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Clearly label Conflict and supporting provenance in Resume output.
scenarios.recovery: Human/source resolution can later produce reviewed successor state; pack regenerates from current qualified state.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Pack generation from same current basis is stable and does not mutate conflict state.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Context Delivery metadata records bounded basis; pack body remains ephemeral by default.

scenarios.scenario: Model-assisted reconciliation yields some valid item results and some invalid/failed results.
scenarios.detection: Structured output validation/evidence-reference validation succeeds only for a subset or Operation fails before atomic durable revision.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Preserve item/operation outcomes without creating a partial Context Revision; invalid outputs cannot fabricate trusted mutations.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show retryable/partial reconciliation state and unaffected reviewed truth.
scenarios.recovery: Retry failed portions or rerun reconciliation against current basis; exact batching mechanism proof-gated.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Retries cannot duplicate valid Proposal items or create partial/duplicate Revisions.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit Operation/item validation outcomes and model provenance.

scenarios.scenario: The model times out or returns invalid/unusable structured output during reconciliation.
scenarios.detection: Timeout, schema validation failure, evidence-reference validation failure or invalid provider response.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Preserve Source/Candidate intake, create no fabricated Proposal/Revision, and leave accepted checkpoint continuity available at lower trust.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Operations show retrying/degraded reconciliation; Resume may include safe pending/unreconciled material distinctly.
scenarios.recovery: Bounded retry and/or explicit allowlisted privacy-compatible fallback, then current-basis reconciliation.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Retries/fallback cannot duplicate intake or durable semantic mutation.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit provider/model/config/schema/policy version, bounded failure, Operation and role without raw sensitive prompt persistence.

scenarios.scenario: A worker crashes mid-operation or after claiming work.
scenarios.detection: Lease/heartbeat/Operation state indicates abandoned in-progress work or process exits before terminal disposition.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Work remains recoverable through leased/idempotent retry; no lost wakeup or duplicate durable side effect.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Operation remains visibly retryable/degraded rather than falsely completed.
scenarios.recovery: Another worker reclaims after proof-gated lease/retry condition and reauthorizes as required.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: At-least-once execution with exactly-once governed effects; lease primitive proof-gated.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit attempt/retry/terminal Operation linkage.

scenarios.scenario: A product schema migration fails or only partially applies in a test/deployment environment.
scenarios.detection: Migration runner/verification reports failure or expected schema invariants are absent.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Block readiness/release and use transactional/forward recovery consistent with migration design; never continue on unknown schema state.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Operational/admin failure only; product should not claim ready.
scenarios.recovery: Repair/forward-fix or rollback where safely supported; exact migration strategy proof-gated in 10A/10T.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Migration reruns/locks cannot apply conflicting schema states.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Deployment/migration audit/logging without secrets.

scenarios.scenario: Project export generation fails after starting but before complete artifact delivery.
scenarios.detection: Export Operation fails or generated artifact fails completeness/integrity validation.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Do not mark export complete or expose a misleading partial artifact as complete.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show failed/retryable export and cleanup status.
scenarios.recovery: Clean partial artifacts and retry from authorized current state.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Duplicate retry must not expose mixed/duplicate artifacts or secrets.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit export Operation and access without logging export contents.

scenarios.scenario: A Developer Credential is suspected or confirmed compromised.
scenarios.detection: User/admin security action or security signal marks credential unsafe.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Revoke/rotate credential, invalidate affected access/grants as applicable, and prevent further authorized use.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show credential revoked/rotation required without re-revealing secret material.
scenarios.recovery: Create a new reveal-once credential only through authorized first-party flow.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Revocation must propagate to concurrent/queued requests before protected side effects.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit credential lifecycle/security response with credential identifier only, never raw secret.
scenarios.requiredProof: Credential revoke/rotate and in-flight denial tests.

scenarios.scenario: A human session is revoked while active or before a sensitive action completes.
scenarios.detection: Session/security-state/step-up recheck reports revoked or insufficiently fresh authentication.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Invalidate access and require fresh authentication/step-up before protected action; preserve pending intent only where securely allowed.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Prompt reauthentication without claiming the protected action succeeded.
scenarios.recovery: Provider-hosted fresh authentication then reauthorize exact pending intent.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Revocation wins over stale session snapshots and prevents duplicate protected effects.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit session revocation and subsequent fresh-auth result.
scenarios.requiredProof: Session revocation during protected action tests.

scenarios.scenario: Authoritative Source state advances beyond the Source coverage of Reviewed Durable Context.
scenarios.detection: Observed/ingested/reconciled Source frontier is ahead of record-level Reviewed Context Source coverage.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Represent divergence truthfully; Reviewed Context may remain older while Source is current/newer and must not be advertised as fully current for affected facts.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Separately show Source freshness and Reviewed coverage/freshness, including pending updates.
scenarios.recovery: Reconciliation/review/automatic eligible flow advances reviewed coverage only after governed semantic mutation.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Coverage advances per relevant record/source basis, not a false single global SHA.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit relevant Source/Context Revision coverage transitions.
scenarios.requiredProof: Source-ahead-of-reviewed fixtures and UI/Resume qualification tests.

scenarios.scenario: Working Context contains a recent assertion that conflicts with Reviewed Durable Context.
scenarios.detection: Normalized Working assertion is incompatible with current Reviewed assertion for overlapping identity/scope.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Keep both planes distinct; Working Context is unreviewed/lower trust and cannot silently replace Reviewed Durable Context.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Resume/review surfaces label the disagreement and trust classes; may create Conflict/Uncertainty according to reconciliation semantics.
scenarios.recovery: Reconcile against evidence and review/policy; accepted correction creates successor Context Revision.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Repeated checkpoints enrich/dedupe semantic candidate state rather than last-writer-wins overwrite.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Preserve Candidate/Working provenance and eventual proposal/revision lineage.
scenarios.requiredProof: Working-versus-Reviewed conflict fixtures and Resume qualification test.

scenarios.scenario: Working Context contradicts current authoritative Source evidence for a category the Source owns.
scenarios.detection: Authority-scoped evidence comparison shows incompatible Working assertion and fresher/current authoritative Source observation.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Authoritative Source evidence wins for current implementation truth; preserve Working assertion as lower-trust/conflicting candidate context and do not silently overwrite either plane.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Resume/review surfaces show authoritative Source versus Working disagreement with provenance/freshness.
scenarios.recovery: Reconcile/review and supersede/correct Working/durable state as governed.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Source authority/freshness—not arrival order—controls current implementation truth.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit authority basis and conflict/reconciliation lineage.

scenarios.scenario: The same logical checkpoint is retried or submitted more than once.
scenarios.detection: Scoped submission/idempotency/deduplication identity or normalized duplicate content indicates repeat intake.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Do not create duplicate semantic updates; retain one canonical Candidate intake/disposition while preserving legitimate delivery audit.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Return stable accepted/pending result rather than duplicate backlog items.
scenarios.recovery: Client may safely retry using idempotency contract.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Concurrent duplicate checkpoint submissions converge on one logical Candidate submission/disposition.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit retries/correlation without duplicating semantic history.

scenarios.scenario: An external AI client checkpoint cannot be bound unambiguously to exactly one authorized Project.
scenarios.detection: Project selection/binding is missing, ambiguous, stale, or conflicts with authenticated grant context.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Fail closed before Candidate acceptance; never guess a Project.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Return explicit project-selection/binding error with only authorized options/metadata.
scenarios.recovery: Client/user supplies an unambiguous authorized Project binding and retries.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Failed ambiguous attempt must not advance Candidate frontier or create semantic state.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit sanitized ambiguous binding attempt and authenticated Integration identity.
scenarios.requiredProof: Ambiguous Project fail-closed multi-host contract tests.

scenarios.scenario: A client submits a checkpoint for a Project it is not granted to access.
scenarios.detection: Authenticated Integration/Credential lacks required Project candidate-write grant.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Deny before intake and disclose no unauthorized Project content.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Generic access denied/not found according to anti-enumeration policy.
scenarios.recovery: Explicit first-party grant creation, then fresh authorized submission.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Unauthorized retries never create Candidate sequence/state.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit denied access with Actor/Integration and Project identifier safely.

scenarios.scenario: A checkpoint contains credentials, API keys or other secret-like material.
scenarios.detection: Deterministic secret scanning flags content before model use/persistence beyond necessary secure intake handling.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Prevent credentials from becoming Context Records/Packs/model inputs; redact/reject/minimize according to security policy.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Return sanitized secret-detected guidance without echoing the secret.
scenarios.recovery: Submit a redacted/minimized checkpoint if appropriate.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Secret-containing retries cannot leak through alternate concurrent path.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit secret-scan classification only; never log raw secret.

scenarios.scenario: Checkpoint payload is malformed or violates contract validation.
scenarios.detection: Deterministic schema/content validation fails before Candidate acceptance.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Reject invalid payload; do not advance Candidate Intake Frontier or call model.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Return bounded validation errors safe for the client.
scenarios.recovery: Correct payload and retry.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Invalid attempts have no semantic side effects.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit validation failure at bounded metadata level.

scenarios.scenario: Checkpoint/Candidate payload exceeds governed intake size limits.
scenarios.detection: Deterministic size enforcement rejects or identifies payload above current configured bound.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Do not send the oversized raw payload to the model. Reject or require bounded/minimized resubmission according to proof-gated limits.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Return payload-too-large/minimization guidance without claiming the checkpoint was accepted if it was not.
scenarios.recovery: Resubmit a bounded checkpoint; exact thresholds remain proof-gated.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Oversized retries have no Candidate frontier side effect unless accepted.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit bounded size metadata and rejection outcome.
scenarios.requiredProof: Boundary/abuse tests around candidate size limits.

scenarios.scenario: Deterministic intake accepts a checkpoint, then the model returns structurally invalid output.
scenarios.detection: Structured-output schema validation or evidence-reference validation fails.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Keep accepted Candidate available as pending/unreconciled; create no Proposal/Revision from invalid output.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Resume may expose safe lower-trust pending continuity and Operations show reconciliation failure/retry.
scenarios.recovery: Retry/fallback under current evidence/frontier basis.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: No duplicate Candidate intake or repeated invalid-output side effect.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit schema/model/provider/prompt-policy versions and validation failure.

scenarios.scenario: Model output cites an evidence reference that does not exist in the authorized reasoning packet/current Project.
scenarios.detection: Deterministic evidence-reference validation cannot resolve the referenced evidence in authorized scope.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Invalidate affected model output; never create trusted semantic mutation from hallucinated/unauthorized evidence.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show reconciliation validation failure or route safe item to review; never display hallucinated evidence as real.
scenarios.recovery: Retry with valid packet/provider output.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Retries do not persist invalid references or duplicate proposals.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit invalid evidence-reference identifiers/hashes safely and model provenance.

scenarios.scenario: Model output references evidence outside the Project/Actor's authorized scope.
scenarios.detection: Evidence-reference authorization validation fails despite syntactic existence.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Invalidate affected output and treat as security boundary failure; never cross Project/tenant scope.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Sanitized reconciliation failure; no unauthorized evidence disclosure.
scenarios.recovery: Rebuild packet from authorized evidence and retry only if appropriate.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: No unauthorized reference can become durable through retry/race.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Security audit with sanitized identifiers and model/Operation provenance.

scenarios.scenario: Primary model provider fails and an unconfigured provider is available technically.
scenarios.detection: Fallback target is not explicitly configured/allowlisted for the Project/environment/privacy policy.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Do not send Project data to the provider. Remain degraded/pending instead of silently routing private content.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show provider degradation/pending status, not an undisclosed fallback.
scenarios.recovery: Explicitly configure/approve a privacy-compatible fallback or wait for primary recovery.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Concurrent fallback attempts all enforce the same allowlist/privacy decision.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit denied/selected fallback provider role without sending sensitive payload to denied provider.

scenarios.scenario: A configured candidate fallback has data-use/retention/privacy terms incompatible with private Project data policy.
scenarios.detection: Provider privacy allowlist/policy evaluation marks provider ineligible for the data class.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Do not transmit private Source/context data; no silent fallback.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show degraded provider state and pending processing.
scenarios.recovery: Use a privacy-compatible allowlisted provider after explicit configuration or wait for recovery.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: All retries preserve provider privacy policy.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit provider-policy decision/version, not raw payload.
scenarios.requiredProof: Privacy allowlist negative tests and current-policy verification process.

scenarios.scenario: Implementation attempts to treat model/provider metadata as the Actor who authorized or approved a change.
scenarios.detection: Audit/Revision attribution uses provider/model identity as authorization Actor.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Reject the attribution model: model metadata is provenance/debug data, not Actor identity or approval authority.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: History/audit shows actual human/system/Integration Actor separately from model provenance.
scenarios.recovery: Correct attribution before governed path ships; historical correction semantics proof-gated.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: NOT_APPLICABLE
scenarios.auditExpectation: Actor and model-provenance fields remain distinct.

scenarios.scenario: An AUTOMATIC Project reconciliation result is a Conflict.
scenarios.detection: Validated semantic classification/current evidence indicates Conflict.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Do not auto-accept; Conflict remains protected and requires first-party human review/resolution.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Place Conflict prominently in review/attention backlog.
scenarios.recovery: Human review/resolution with current evidence and successor Revision if accepted.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Repeated automatic evaluations cannot bypass protected classification.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit protected-class routing and eventual human decision.

scenarios.scenario: An AUTOMATIC Project reconciliation result remains Uncertain/insufficiently established.
scenarios.detection: Evidence/output validation cannot positively establish eligible current truth.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Do not auto-accept; Uncertainty is protected and routed to human review/continued Working Context.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show Uncertainty distinctly from Conflict.
scenarios.recovery: Gather evidence or human decision then re-evaluate/revise.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Repeated model confidence cannot convert unresolved uncertainty to approval authority.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit uncertainty basis and protected routing.

scenarios.scenario: A candidate change would alter Source Authority or materially change repository/default-branch/topology authority consequences.
scenarios.detection: Semantic/policy classification identifies Source Authority or material topology/currentness change.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Block automatic acceptance; require first-party high-integrity human flow with step-up where required.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show protected high-integrity change and impacted records/scopes.
scenarios.recovery: Authorized human confirms/edits/rejects and system revalidates affected context.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Concurrent policy/model output cannot apply authority changes without protected flow.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit human Actor, step-up, before/after authority/topology basis.

scenarios.scenario: An AUTOMATIC Project item is stale or requires revalidation.
scenarios.detection: Relevant basis has changed or freshness/revalidation flag is set.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Block automatic acceptance until current-basis revalidation succeeds; stale/revalidation-required class remains human-review-only when still protected.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show revalidation-required/stale state.
scenarios.recovery: Revalidate using current Source/Candidate/Context basis.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: No stale auto-commit under concurrent frontier change.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit stale detection and revalidation outcome.

scenarios.scenario: Candidate semantic change affects security-sensitive constraints/configuration/intent.
scenarios.detection: Deterministic semantic/policy classification places item in security-sensitive protected class.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Do not auto-accept; require first-party human review and appropriate step-up/authorization.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show security-sensitive protected review state without leaking secrets.
scenarios.recovery: Human review with evidence and successor Revision if accepted.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: No model/policy race can bypass protected security class.
scenarios.auditExpectation: High-integrity audit with human Actor and sanitized change metadata.

scenarios.scenario: Candidate change proposes destructive/high-impact semantic removal or obsoletion.
scenarios.detection: Policy classification identifies destructive/high-impact removal.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Do not auto-accept; first-party human review required.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show removal impact and evidence before decision.
scenarios.recovery: Human approve/edit/reject with current-basis revalidation.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Concurrent automatic evaluation cannot remove reviewed truth without protected decision.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit proposed/decided removal and affected identities.

scenarios.scenario: Primary and verifier/model/evidence checks disagree on a candidate semantic result.
scenarios.detection: Configured reasoning/verification paths produce material disagreement.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Treat as protected; no automatic durable mutation.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show review-needed/uncertain disagreement with bounded provenance.
scenarios.recovery: Human review or fresh reconciliation under current evidence.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Repeated attempts cannot choose a preferred model merely to force eligibility.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit primary/verifier roles and disagreement metadata.

scenarios.scenario: A candidate lacks sufficient provenance/evidence/origin basis for automatic eligibility.
scenarios.detection: Deterministic eligibility validation cannot positively prove the required basis.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Do not auto-accept; keep as Working/review candidate or reject according to evidence validity.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show insufficient provenance/origin qualification.
scenarios.recovery: Attach valid evidence/confirmation and re-evaluate.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Absence of proof remains denial under every concurrent/retry path.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit eligibility denial reason.

scenarios.scenario: A Project's primary GitHub repository is proposed to be replaced with another repository.
scenarios.detection: Stable provider repository identity differs and workflow is a replacement rather than rename/transfer metadata update.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Never infer replacement from display identity; require explicit first-party high-integrity workflow with protected authority/currentness consequences.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show replacement impact and require explicit confirmation/step-up.
scenarios.recovery: Complete governed replacement/catch-up/revalidation or cancel with old repository intact.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Concurrent provider metadata events cannot silently trigger replacement.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit human Actor, old/new stable repository IDs and revalidation operation.

scenarios.scenario: GitHub repository default branch changes.
scenarios.detection: Provider metadata refetch reports a different default branch.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Treat as material currentness/authority implication, preserve provenance and protect semantic consequences; do not silently remap branch-only evidence into current truth.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Surface default-branch/currentness change and revalidation where material.
scenarios.recovery: Catch up new default branch and revalidate affected Source/Working/Reviewed context.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Old/new branch events cannot race into mixed current truth.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit default-branch metadata transition and affected revalidation.

scenarios.scenario: A non-default branch referenced by historical/Working evidence is deleted.
scenarios.detection: Provider refetch shows branch/ref no longer available.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Update availability/freshness while preserving historical Memoid provenance; do not erase history merely because ref disappeared.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show branch unavailable/deleted and historical qualification.
scenarios.recovery: No restoration required unless branch reappears; revalidate any work depending on live availability.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Duplicate deletion events do not delete historical evidence twice.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit ref availability transition.

scenarios.scenario: An ordinary external MCP/API AI client attempts to trigger GitHub/Source refresh or synchronization.
scenarios.detection: Client invokes/requests a capability outside its allowed read/search/candidate/status scope.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Deny the refresh capability. Source catch-up remains Memoid/server-controlled (plus later explicitly authorized first-party 'check now' where allowed).
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Return capability denied/not supported rather than initiating Source processing.
scenarios.recovery: Wait for server catch-up or use a future authorized first-party control.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Repeated attempts cannot enqueue refresh work.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit denied capability attempt with authenticated Integration identity.

scenarios.scenario: A Source reconnect reveals provider state advanced while Memoid was disconnected.
scenarios.detection: Reconnect/current-ref comparison is ahead of Memoid observed/desired/ingested frontier.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Advance desired frontier and run server-controlled incremental catch-up before claiming freshness.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show reconnecting/catching-up Source and truthful coverage gap.
scenarios.recovery: Ingest/reconcile until convergence; revalidate affected reviewed/working state.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Reconnect and late webhook processing converge without duplicate semantic work.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit reconnect gap and catch-up operation.

scenarios.scenario: Scheduled integrity check finds GitHub current ref/SHA ahead of Memoid despite no recent usable webhook.
scenarios.detection: Provider comparison shows current ref differs from observed/desired Source frontier.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Advance desired frontier and schedule incremental catch-up/reconciliation.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show Source catching up/stale only when divergence affects trust.
scenarios.recovery: Process until current provider state converges or truthful failure remains.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Repeated checks are idempotent and must preserve newer desired frontiers.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit detected gap and catch-up operation.

scenarios.scenario: A repository/monorepo change touches a huge number of files/LOC including generated files, binaries, lockfiles, LFS or submodules.
scenarios.detection: Diff/tree/path/size/type classification crosses configured processing bounds or contains excluded content classes.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Use hybrid incremental filtering/structural extraction/semantic grouping/scoped retrieval; never send the entire repository to the model or retain a full repository mirror.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show bounded processing/degraded/unsupported-file status where relevant, not false completeness.
scenarios.recovery: Process eligible scopes incrementally; exact thresholds/chunking remain proof-gated and benchmark-driven.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Retries/coalescing preserve frontier identity and avoid duplicate full-repo processing.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit bounded path/count/size processing metadata, not unnecessary file contents.
scenarios.requiredProof: Large-repository/huge-diff corpus load and filtering tests.

scenarios.scenario: Changed paths are generated/binary/lockfile/LFS/submodule material with low or special semantic value.
scenarios.detection: Deterministic file/path/type filters classify the changed material.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Apply deterministic inclusion/exclusion/special handling before model reasoning; do not blindly spend model budget on noise.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Normally none; Source coverage must remain truthful about excluded/unsupported classes.
scenarios.recovery: Adjust proof-gated filters only with benchmark/evidence, not ad hoc model behavior.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Deterministic filters yield stable classification across retries for same inputs/config version.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Record filter/config version and bounded path metadata.

scenarios.scenario: Coalescing/semantic grouping attempts to combine distinct Project-context changes incorrectly.
scenarios.detection: Validation/benchmark shows grouped evidence spans incompatible identities/categories/branches/authority scopes.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Preserve distinct semantic changes/provenance; coalescing provider events must not erase meaningful intermediate evidence.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Manual backlog remains semantic and inspectable rather than one misleading aggregate item.
scenarios.recovery: Split/regroup using deterministic boundaries and model-assisted reasoning subject to validation.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Regrouping retries cannot duplicate Proposal items or lose lineage.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Preserve evidence/grouping policy version and lineage.
scenarios.requiredProof: Semantic grouping/dedup benchmark fixtures including burst history.

scenarios.scenario: A MANUAL Project accumulates pending semantic backlog over long inactivity while Sources/Working state continue changing.
scenarios.detection: Pending items age and their captured Source/Candidate/Context basis becomes stale or superseded.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Keep backlog semantic, mark stale/superseded/revalidation-required items, preserve Conflict priority, and support safe future batch decisions without event-per-push noise.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: After 24h/30d, user sees grouped current backlog with freshness, staleness, supersession and Conflict/Uncertainty distinctions.
scenarios.recovery: Revalidate affected items before decision; safe batch actions operate only on current eligible items.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Background enrichment/revalidation cannot silently accept MANUAL items or duplicate backlog semantics.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit revalidation/supersession/decisions, not every UI grouping render.
scenarios.requiredProof: Manual backlog 50-push/24h/30d fixtures and safe-batch tests.

scenarios.scenario: Later checkpoints/evidence repeat a pending semantic item but add useful provenance/rationale/evidence.
scenarios.detection: Semantic identity matches pending item while evidence/provenance set is enriched.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Enrich/deduplicate semantic backlog without creating one review item per event or losing new provenance.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show one semantic item with accumulated relevant evidence/history.
scenarios.recovery: NOT_APPLICABLE
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Concurrent enrichment merges deterministically without duplicate Proposal Items.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Preserve Candidate/evidence lineage for enrichment.

scenarios.scenario: A newer candidate/evidence state supersedes an older still-pending semantic item before review.
scenarios.detection: Semantic lineage establishes newer state replaces the older pending assertion under current basis.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Mark older pending item superseded/stale rather than asking the user to approve obsolete state.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Backlog emphasizes current successor while retaining inspectable history/provenance.
scenarios.recovery: Review/revalidate successor item only as appropriate.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Concurrent successor arrivals preserve one ordered semantic lineage.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit supersession relationship and evidence lineage.

scenarios.scenario: A client requests Resume while one or more relevant authoritative Sources are stale/unavailable.
scenarios.detection: Selected context depends on Source whose freshness/current-ref cannot be established.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Return minimum qualified context with explicit Source staleness/unavailability and avoid presenting affected reviewed/working facts as unquestionably current.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Resume includes clear freshness/degraded qualification and blockers/conflicts as relevant.
scenarios.recovery: Server catch-up/refetch later restores freshness and future packs use current basis.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Pack generation must not mutate Source frontier or trigger external-client refresh privilege.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Delivery metadata records bounded Source coverage/freshness basis; body ephemeral by default.

scenarios.scenario: A client requests Resume while meaningful recent Candidate/Working changes remain pending human review.
scenarios.detection: Task selection intersects relevant pending/unreviewed semantic continuity.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: May include relevant Working/pending continuity only with explicit lower-trust qualification; it cannot override Reviewed/authoritative state.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Resume clearly distinguishes reviewed, working, pending, conflict and uncertainty classes.
scenarios.recovery: After review/reconciliation, later Resume reflects successor durable/current state.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Pack read must not auto-review or mutate pending items.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Delivery metadata records trust-class basis without retaining pack body by default.

scenarios.scenario: A new authorized client requests Resume while reconciliation provider is degraded and recent accepted checkpoints are unreconciled.
scenarios.detection: Relevant Candidate intake exists beyond reconciled frontier and provider Operation is waiting/retrying/degraded.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Keep recent safe accepted material visible as explicit pending/unreconciled lower-trust continuity while preserving Reviewed/Source precedence and Conflict/Uncertainty.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Resume/Operations disclose provider degradation and pending trust class; recent work does not disappear.
scenarios.recovery: Reconcile after provider recovery/fallback; future Resume updates accordingly.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Resume reads cannot advance Candidate reconciled frontier or fabricate reconciliation.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Delivery metadata plus provider Operation/correlation provenance, no raw sensitive prompt retention.
scenarios.requiredProof: Cross-client Resume during provider outage/quota/invalid-output tests.

scenarios.scenario: Compaction would drop material meaning such as rationale, constraint, assumption, conflict, uncertainty, supersession reason, provenance or next action.
scenarios.detection: Benchmark/validation compares compacted packet/output against required semantic fields and detects material loss.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Reject or regenerate the compaction result; never reduce meaningful rationale to a misleading bare fact when rationale is required.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: No misleading compacted context is served as equivalent truth; degraded/retry behavior is acceptable.
scenarios.recovery: Retry with adjusted compaction/retrieval strategy; exact token budgets remain proof-gated.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Compaction retries must preserve evidence identity and current frontier basis.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit compaction policy/version and benchmark failure at bounded metadata level.
scenarios.requiredProof: Frozen compaction benchmark including rationale/constraint/conflict preservation.

scenarios.scenario: An implementation attempts to use one generic summarizer abstraction as both reconciliation and Resume semantics.
scenarios.detection: Contract/architecture inspection or tests show the same pipeline fails to distinguish 'what changed durably?' from 'what minimum qualified context is needed now?'.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Keep Reconciliation and Resume/Context Pack generation as separate semantic pipelines sharing only lower-level validated primitives where appropriate.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: User-facing outputs retain their distinct purposes: change/review state versus task-specific qualified continuation context.
scenarios.recovery: Refactor before exposing governed path; exact provider prompt/schema names remain proof-gated.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Shared infrastructure must not cause one pipeline's retries/frontiers/trust rules to mutate the other incorrectly.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit/provenance metadata identifies the operation/pipeline role.
scenarios.requiredProof: Architecture/contract tests plus representative reconciliation vs Resume fixtures.

scenarios.scenario: A Project is archived while candidate/source/reconciliation/review jobs are queued or in flight.
scenarios.detection: Project lifecycle becomes archived before queued or mid-flight work reaches protected side effects.
scenarios.requiredBehavior: Fence or reauthorize queued/mid-flight work so archive semantics are respected; do not create new active trusted mutations that violate archived state.
scenarios.userVisibleBehavior: Show archived state and any cancelled/paused operations; history remains inspectable according to policy.
scenarios.recovery: Restore through governed flow, then explicitly retry/reconcile only work that remains valid under current authorization/frontiers.
scenarios.idempotencyConcurrency: Archive transition must win over stale queued authorization/state snapshots.
scenarios.auditExpectation: Audit archive transition, fenced operations and any later restore/retry.
scenarios.requiredProof: Archive-with-queued-work race test and restore reauthorization proof.
